_comment: B1.2 vocabulary, hand-written against data/blueprints-b1.json. The last level, and the one with most overlap: A2.1 u14 already covers filling in a form, B1.1 u18 already covers contract terms, B1.1 u8 already covers employment basics. So u7 here is what happens after you hand the form in, u8 is the rights inside the contract, and u9 is the workplace as a place with conflicts.
